items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy and Percy and Milt Jackson and Jeff Davis and Joe Harris, the drummer -- and myself.

ctx.x: He didn't go to Chicago with you.

No, he didn't go to Chicago. I had Little Jimmy Heath with me. Jimmy and Percy and Milt Jackson and Jeff Davis and Joe Harris, the drummer -- and myself. And a guy named Willie Smith, a little tenor player; he was from California, too.
And Jimmy was playing alto then.
